On a review, and in exercise of the powers conferred by the section 35A read with Section 56 of the Banking Regulation Act, 1949, the Reserve Bank being satisfied that it is necessary and expedient in the public interest so to do, hereby issues the Amendment Directions hereinafter specified. 3. The Amendment Directions modifies the Directions as under: (1) Following shall be added to Annex I: “2. AgriSURE - Agri Fund for Start Ups & Rural Enterprises” 4. The above amendment shall come into force with immediate effect. (Vaibhav Chaturvedi) Chief General Manager -- 1 of 1 --
